directive.quote: Finish the port of the film repository so it can be retired: move each job to its correct home, porting the correct parts one to one and never rebuilding from scratch what already worked; move the code byte for byte, then make what it fixed arguments and settings.

targets.baseline_commit_message: check-every-claim-against-its-facts-and-sources: a film's fact gate, source extracts and world reader, moved byte for byte

preserve: the extract builders html, fdc-json, new-order and copy, unchanged
a kind with no builder keeps its own extract and is refused when it is missing
raw and text paths relative to the sources file's folder
allowed_deltas: the sources file is a request field instead of the folder beside the script
one JSON answer as the last line; the per-source lines go to standard error
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it.
